place.name: National Park Neusiedler See-Seewinkel
place.description: Neusiedler See-Seewinkel National Park (German: Nationalpark Neusiedler See-Seewinkel) is a national park in eastern Austria. The park extends over an area of 97 square kilometres of the province of Burgenland and protects parts of an endorheic and westernmost lake of the Eurasian Steppe.
